text:
Ariya Chen: Quick sync — we should standardize a single "pairwise rollout diff" panel in Console that combines runtime and infra signals for any rollout/A-B. Thinking minimal surface: p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, request throughput (rps), tokens/sec, GPU util, queue depth, and fallback/model-switch counts.
Sanjay Patel: +1. We need to be careful about cardinality — per-route + model + region explodes. Suggest default to route+model, with a dropdown for region.
Kelly Morales: Agree on dropdown. Also want a single column that shows % regression vs baseline and a sparkline. Quick sketch: left col metric list, middle col pairwise diff, right col raw series.
Benji Ortega: For telemetry, runtime needs to export labels: rollout_id, variant, route, model_version, region. Also emit events: rollout.start, rollout.snapshot.baseline, rollout.snapshot.variant, rollout.end. Those events will let us align windows.
Maria Gomez: Can we align windows by request time rather than event time? We get noisy timestamps from some proxies. If not, we need to include sample_count and sampling_rate in events.
Ariya Chen: Good call — include sample_rate and window_seconds. Plan: runtime emits rollout.window {rollout_id, variant, start_ts, end_ts, sample_rate}. Dashboard uses that to stitch series.
Sanjay Patel: Example PromQL draft for p95 diff (very rough):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket{rollout_id="$ROLL"}[5m])) by (le, variant))
```
Then do variant/baseline ratio. We should publish a small library helper to generate these queries.
Kelly Morales: UX ask: show absolute delta and relative %. Also flag when delta >= X for 5 consecutive windows. Add a small table of top error codes and top prompt lengths.
Benji Ortega: Runtime export items to add: request_latency_bucket, request_errors_total{code}, tokens_generated_total, model_fallbacks_total, queue_depth_gauge, gpu_util_percent. I'll open an infra PR.
Maria Gomez: Can we include a deterministic synthetic traffic marker? e.g., rollout.synthetic=true so we can filter out load-tests.
Ariya Chen: Yes. We'll reserve a label synthetic=true/false. Also plan to expose an API in Console: /api/rollouts/{id}/compare that returns aligned series for frontend. That API will be backed by a small aggregator service.
Sanjay Patel: SLA/alerting note: For A/B we need both regression alerts (variant worse than baseline) and anomaly alerts (both drifting). Define baseline window = last N minutes before rollout and compare against rollout window.
Kelly Morales: Also add a tiny histogram of prompt token lengths; short prompts behave differently.
Benji Ortega: I'll add metrics and the rollout events this week. PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/321 (draft).
Maria Gomez: I'll mock the Console wireframe and post a Figma link by EOD.
Ariya Chen: Action items: Benji - runtime metrics + events PR; Maria - wireframe; Sanjay - helper query lib; Kelly - UX copy for thresholds; Ariya - API spec for /api/rollouts/{id}/compare.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: telemetry-agent v0.42 -> staging (will include new labels).
Kelly Morales: tiny nit: include timezone or always use epoch seconds in events.
Benji Ortega: using epoch secs.
Ariya Chen: Thanks all. We'll meet async on thread for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
